words.prose: {{ar:تَقْوَىٰهَا}} ({{tr:taqwāhā}}) closes the inspired pair with the soul's own guarding capacity. The suffix keeps the soul from 91:7 as the referential center, and the coordination makes this word the second content object under the same act of inspiration, not a later achievement. The root's protection and barrier field makes taqwā more concrete than a flat label for piety: it is protective moral awareness, a self-guarding posture placed opposite the breach image of {{ar:فُجُورَهَا}} ({{tr:fujūrahā}}). Because the surface is a possessed abstract noun, the ayah is not yet commanding the soul with imperative guarding forms or labeling it as already pious; it describes a capacity made known within it. Against the cosmic oath frame of 91:1-7, the soul's own guarding capacity answers the larger order without making taqwā itself a cosmic-function term. baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative verb at word 1 governs the two coordinated, soul-possessed nouns at words 2 and 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: The soul is made to take in a paired interior repertoire: one mode breaches restraint and the other places the self within protection. Inspiration is therefore embodied assimilation of actionable orientations, not merely receipt of two definitions.

activation_trace.role: Complete swallowing supplies the intake image and makes the causative act an inward assimilation of the pair.
Departure from right through breached restraint supplies the outwardly transgressive orientation taken into the soul.
Placing oneself in protective caution supplies the counter-orientation as an enacted self-positioning.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports that the soul is informed which abstract category is wickedness and which is piety.
changed_reading.after: The verse depicts a soul made to internalize two executable orientations—breaching restraint and taking protective position—as capacities belonging to its own constitution.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The juxtaposition of the two possessive nouns at words 2–3 makes their opposed root mechanics operate on one interior boundary.
baseline_models.mechanism: Fujur opens a wide rupture through which stored pressure can issue; taqwa interposes a guard against harm. Their coordination models moral agency as regulation of permeability: whether an interior force becomes uncontrolled outflow or remains behind a protective threshold.

activation_trace.role: Wide splitting and outflow provide the opening operation and its capacity to release what was contained.
A barrier that wards off harm provides the opposed operation of preserving a boundary.
Breadth and abundance make the inspired endowment capacious enough to contain both opposed boundary operations.

changed_reading.before: Fujur and taqwa are two static moral labels deposited side by side.
changed_reading.after: They are opposed operations on a shared threshold—rupture/outflow and protective interposition—installed within one capacious soul.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The singular act of inspiration at word 1 contains both the potentially eruptive noun at word 2 and the protective noun at word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: The pair is not dynamically symmetrical. Fujur can arrive as sudden multiplying pressure, while taqwa functions as prior protection against engulfment; the verse can thus map an internal hazard and its countermeasure rather than two equally placid options.

activation_trace.role: An engulfing calamity supplies the hazard horizon within which inspiration includes recognition of what can consume the agent.
A sudden bursting-in of many supplies the nonlinear escalation associated with the hazardous orientation.
Warding harm with a barrier supplies the anticipatory countermeasure rather than a second kind of eruption.

changed_reading.before: The two inspired possibilities are balanced items in a neutral inventory.
changed_reading.after: The construction may encode an asymmetric risk topology: an eruptive capacity that can engulf and a protective capacity meant to precede and contain it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ordered context supplies succession, uncovering, and covering. These operations revise the focus pair from fixed contents into alternating modes of moral visibility: rupture can break into disclosure, while protection can cover without erasing what is covered.

activation_trace.role: Dawn breaking from night makes the focus noun capable of registering emergence into visibility as well as moral breach.
Protective covering supplies a bounded concealment that preserves rather than annihilates.
Following and succession make the reveal-cover relation temporal rather than a frozen opposition.
Uncovering and appearance provide the explicit disclosure phase that sharpens the dawn activation in fujur.
A cover rising over and veiling a thing supplies the reversible occlusion that distinguishes protection from destruction.

structural_cues: The repeated temporal particle and feminine object suffix across 91:2–4 create an ordered reveal-cover sequence before the focus pair receives its own repeated feminine suffixes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies succession, disclosure, and covering; I infer that their ordered alternation can model changing access to the soul's inspired capacities. A live alternative is that the sequence remains purely cosmic and contributes rhythm, not psychodynamics.

changed_reading.before: The soul permanently sees two fully explicit moral objects.
changed_reading.after: Its inspired discernment can be read as phased visibility: orientations emerge, become manifest, and can be protectively covered without ceasing to belong to the soul.

context_deltas.mechanism: Assembly, spatial extension, and completed proportioning culminate immediately in inspiration; the later recurrence of equalizing after destruction gives the same root a terminal edge. The focus becomes the hinge inside a constructed order: an interior boundary system is installed after formation and tested before a final leveling.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies joining, spreading, completion, and later equalization; I infer a formation–interior endowment–terminal leveling arc. The live alternative is rhetorical parallelism without a causal claim that the moral pair is architectural.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same material operation—a split—can be a ruinous breach or a cultivated furrow. Growth follows opened and tended ground, whereas failure follows concealment and corruption. This revises moral polarity: openness is not intrinsically fujur, and containment is not intrinsically taqwa; purpose and care decide whether the boundary operation fructifies, protects, ruptures, or buries.

activation_trace.role: Wide splitting and outflow supply the raw opening whose moral direction is put under pressure by the later cultivation image.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies split, plowing, growth, failed attainment, concealment, and corruption; I infer that shared material operations are morally differentiated by direction and outcome. A live alternative keeps the agricultural branches as etymic resonance only and treats fujur as lexically fixed wickedness.

changed_reading.before: Every opening belongs to fujur, while every form of restraint or concealment belongs to taqwa.
changed_reading.after: Opening can become a fertile furrow or a destructive breach, and containment can become a protective barrier or corruptive burial; the inspired discernment concerns how an operation is governed, not just which geometry it has.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context turns an inward capacity into a motor sequence: stillness is stirred, movement launches, another body's movement is disabled, and the cascade ends in eradication. This strengthens the baseline claim that the inspired pair is executable; fujur is a transition from latent pressure to mobilized harm, while taqwa is the capacity to interrupt that transition.

activation_trace.role: Sudden bursting-in supplies the nonlinear transition from an inner disposition to an event already in motion.

structural_cues: The temporal opening at 91:12 and the repeated result-linking particles in 91:13–14 compress arousal, warning, injury, and consequence into a rapid sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies arousal, forward motion, disabled legs, and eradication; I supply the causal arrow from interior activation to cascading action and the claim that taqwa can interrupt it. A live alternative treats these as features of one narrated event rather than a general motor model of the focus pair.

changed_reading.before: Fujur and taqwa remain private mental recognitions after inspiration.
changed_reading.after: They are action architectures: one can ignite into a fast, self-amplifying chain of embodied harm, while the other is a pre-action protective positioning.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from inward inspiration at 91:8 to denial at 91:11, explicit messenger-speech at 91:13, and renewed denial at 91:14.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inward uptake, inner saying, signification, messenger-speech, and denial; I infer that the external warning reactivates an already available inner distinction. A live alternative is that inner inspiration and historical messenger-speech are parallel but independent channels.

changed_reading.before: Inspiration either compels conduct or is too private to bear on later public warning.
changed_reading.after: It can be noncoercive inward testimony: public speech gives the assimilated distinction an external voice, while denial remains a possible active response.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus rupture/barrier pair is externalized as water governance. Force rises beyond a limit, watering has a share and channel, and downstream channels or a full bucket carry the flow onward. Fujur becomes pressure escaping its proper course; taqwa becomes preservation of banks, shares, and downstream life.

activation_trace.role: Wide splitting with water-like outflow supplies the breach through which pressure escapes.
A harm-blocking barrier supplies the bank or guard that keeps force within a life-preserving limit.
Rising water and sweeping force make transgression a pressure that overtops its limit.
The non-dominant mapped inventory independently preserves water-overflow as a convergent image for limit-crossing.

Water channels at valley-ends supply the downstream path along which a boundary failure propagates.
A full bucket supplies a finite portion whose fullness can sustain allocation or become excess when mishandled.

structural_cues: The ordered movement from excess at 91:11 through watering at 91:13 to culpable consequence at 91:14 places limit, resource, and aftermath in one sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies overtopping force, an allotted watering channel, downstream channels, and a protective barrier; I infer a hydraulic governance model and the direction from failed limit to propagated harm. A live alternative leaves these as independent lexical images with no shared ecology.

changed_reading.before: Fujur is an isolated bad choice and taqwa an isolated good state.
changed_reading.after: Fujur is unmanaged overflow that breaches a shared channel, whereas taqwa is ecological limit-keeping that protects apportioned access and downstream consequences.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sanctity violation, a divinely related animal, a watering share, bodily disabling, and protection; I infer that these constitute a protected-rights mechanism. A live alternative confines the episode to a singular sacred prohibition rather than a general social reading of taqwa.

changed_reading.before: The inspired pair concerns only private self-management.
changed_reading.after: It also concerns relational boundaries: fujur violates another's protected body and allocation, while taqwa guards claims that do not originate in the self.

context_deltas.mechanism: Following, tail/end, residue, and outcome activate a temporal reading of the possessive pair. Each orientation has a train that follows it: the inspired capacity is not exhausted in the instant of choice but includes awareness that acts acquire tails, traces, and aftermaths.

changed_reading.after: It distinguishes two trajectories whose acts carry a following tail, moral residue, and eventual outcome.

activation_trace.role: Complete assimilation supplies the interior location in which a discriminating mark or property could be installed.

strongest_changes: The focus pair shifted from abstract labels to embodied operations: assimilated rupture/outflow and protective self-positioning.
The cultivation sequence made opening morally nonuniform: the same split can become fertile furrow or destructive breach, while protection differs sharply from corruptive burial.
Overflow, watering share, sanctity, and bodily injury externalized the pair into ecological and social boundary-keeping rather than private morality alone.
Formation, mobilization, and aftermath made inspiration a hinge between built-in capacity, executable action, and consequence-bearing trajectories.
summary.what_was_special: The richest activations came from material homologies that a conservative gloss would flatten: split versus plowed furrow, barrier versus burial, overflow versus apportioned channel, and guarded hoof-placement versus disabling an animal's legs. Split root mappings also preserved a live but carefully contained reading of inspiration as an inwardly legible mark.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal arrows from ordered context images to an interior mechanism are reader-supplied; the packet guarantees sequence and branch images, not psychological causation.
The dawn, measure, devouring-speed, hoof-gait, and non-dominant mapped-root readings are branch-distant and should remain exploratory analogies rather than lexical substitutions.
Repeated feminine suffixes and repeated equalizing language create strong structural resonance without proving that every occurrence has one identical referent or function.
The final negated fear distinguishes affect from protection only obliquely because its grammatical subject may not be the human soul.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Inspiration as complete intake of two moral disclosures.** Lexical evidence: ل ه م B001 "swallowing and taking something in completely"; ف ج ر B004 "departure from right and breach of restraint"; و ق ي B002 "placing the self in protective caution." Structural cue: the verb ألهمها takes the soul as object, then gives two paired possessives: its فجور and its تقوى. Assigned role: ilham is ingestion/internalization; fujur and taqwa are the two knowable inner directions. Abductive move: I infer that the soul receives not merely data but an internal capacity to recognize both breach and guard; the packet supplies intake, breach, and caution branches. Reading change: the ayah reads less like external command and more like implanted discernment swallowed into the self.

2. **Fujur as split/outflow, taqwa as barrier/containment.** Lexical evidence: ف ج ر B001 "wide splitting and outflow"; و ق ي B001 "warding harm off with a protective barrier"; ن ه ر B003 opening/widening until flow in 91:3; س ق ي B003 irrigation channel in 91:13. Structural cue: the two nouns stand as opposites after the fashioned self. Assigned role: فجور is uncontrolled breach-flow; تقوى is protective containment. Abductive move: I supply the hydraulic moral model: water-like force must be channeled rather than burst out destructively; the packet supplies split/outflow, barrier, river opening, and watering. Reading change: the moral pair becomes material: sin is rupture of bounds, piety is guarding the channel.

3. **Taqwa as guarded gait after pain.** Lexical evidence: و ق ي B003 "guarded gait from hoof pain"; ع ق ر B002 "cutting an animal down" and B003 "disabling back or movement" in 91:14; ن و ق B002 she-camel in 91:13. Structural cue: the later narrative centers on a she-camel being hamstrung. Assigned role: the hoof-pain branch gives taqwa a bodily caution around vulnerable movement. Abductive move: I infer retroactively that proper guarding includes not violating another creature's protected movement; the packet supplies hoof-guarding, she-camel, and hamstringing. Reading change: تقواها is not abstract religiosity only; it becomes careful movement around the vulnerable body and its rights.

4. **Fujur as false dawn versus true dawn.** Lexical evidence: ف ج ر B002 "dawn breaking from night, true and false dawn distinction"; ك ذ ب B001 falsehood and B002 declaring false in 91:11/14; ج ل و B001 manifestation. Structural cue: the packet pairs revelation/unveiling with later denial. Assigned role: fujur's dawn branch introduces an ambiguous light that can mislead if not guarded. Abductive move: I infer that the soul must distinguish real disclosure from deceptive appearance; the packet supplies dawn distinction and deception/denial branches. Reading change: فجورها can include not only immoral overflow but a false-light epistemology that prepares the people's تكذيب.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 91:13–14 made تقوى more concrete than abstract piety: the protected she-camel and her watering right activate و ق ي as guarding a vulnerable boundary in the material world. The hoof-pain branch of و ق ي, which first seemed marginal, became surprisingly apt once عقر appeared as disabling the animal's movement.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Two opposed boundary mechanics.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ف ج ر/B001` is a wide split and outflow and `ف ج ر/B004` is a breach of restraint; fixed `و ق ي/B001` is a barrier that wards harm and `و ق ي/B002` is placing the self in protective caution. **Structural cue and role:** `فجورها` and `تقواها` are coordinated as contents of one formed self, so the first functions as rupture and the second as boundary maintenance. **Abductive move:** the opposed branch images and syntax are supplied; modeling moral alternatives as permeability control is inferred. **Reading change:** the pair becomes an operational contrast between breaking a limit and maintaining a guard, not merely two abstract labels.

2. **Inspiration as complete inward uptake.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ل ه م/B001` is swallowing or taking something in completely. **Structural cue and role:** the causative form `ألهم` acts on the self immediately after its formation and takes two explicit objects through the pronominal construction; the swallowing image gives the self the role of an inward recipient. **Abductive move:** the packet supplies the root image and causative grammar; reversing ordinary ingestion into "a source causes the self to internalize" is the inferred directional arrow. **Reading change:** inspiration reads as embodied incorporation of moral knowledge rather than information merely placed nearby.

3. **`فجور` can arrive with the phenomenology of dawn.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ف ج ر/B002` is dawn breaking from night, while `ف ج ر/B004` is moral breach. **Structural cue and role:** 91:3-4 established manifestation against covering, and `فجورها` now carries both an opening-light image and a transgressive one. **Abductive move:** coexistence of accepted branches is supplied; inferring that a breach may first present itself as disclosure or release is exploratory and does not erase the wickedness branch. **Reading change:** awareness of `فجور` includes the danger that boundary-breaking can feel like illumination.

4. **`تقوى` as a guarded gait across bounded terrain.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `و ق ي/B003` is the cautious gait of an animal protecting a hurt hoof; contextual 91:6 spreads the earth, 91:12 has a forceful setting-out, and 91:13 names a she-camel and her water allotment. **Structural cue and role:** locomotion and a vulnerable resource boundary surround the fixed ayah, so caution functions as measured movement that avoids injuring what must be protected. **Abductive move:** the movement images are packet-given; applying the animal gait materially to moral conduct is analogical. **Reading change:** `تقواها` becomes practiced restraint in how one advances through shared space, not fear held only inside.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 91:9-10 showed that inward uptake does not determine one outcome; it equips action in either direction. The sharper later surprise came from 91:12-13: forceful setting-out followed by a she-camel's water entitlement made `و ق ي/B003` legible as guarded movement around a vulnerable boundary.

baseline.text: Sonra ona kötülüğünü ve sakınmasını ilham edene,

findings.text: İlham, kötülük ile sakınma bilgisinin cana yalnızca bildirilmesi değil, onun içine bütünüyle alınmasıdır.
Kötülük sınırı yarıp taşan bir kuvvet, sakınma ise zararı durduran ve sınırı koruyan bir engel gibi karşı karşıya gelir.
Sakınma, incinmiş bir ayağı koruyan dikkatli yürüyüş gibi, ileride devenin hareketine ve su hakkına zarar vermeden ortak alanda ilerleme biçimine dönüşür.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Dawn as Aperture and Breath

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi büyüklük ve genişlik eksenini; yeterince büyük olan, bol veren, sütü bol, sayıca çok ordu ve iri hayvan kullanımlarıyla destekler. Dal korunabilir, ancak bu kullanımlar tek bir nesne türünün eş anlamlı adları değil, büyüklük veya bolluğun farklı bağlamlardaki gerçekleşmeleridir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, biçimlerdeki büyüklük ve cömertliği; hayvan, insan ve ordu nitelemelerindeki bağlama bağlı bolluk ve çokluk kullanımlarından ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Büyüklük, genişlik veya bolluğun bağlama göre yeterince büyük olma, çok verme, bol süt sağlama, sayıca çok olup içindekini görünmez kılma ya da iri hayvan olma biçiminde gerçekleşmesidir. Bu gerçekleşmeler ortak bir fazlalık ekseninde buluşur, fakat birbirinin yerine geçmez.

facets.statement: Bir varlığın büyüklük, genişlik veya yeterlilik bakımından belirgin olması.
İnsan veya atın cömert ve çok veren olarak nitelenmesi.
Dişi devenin çok süt veren, sütü bol bir hayvan olarak nitelenmesi.
Ordunun sayıca çok olup ortasında bulunanları görünmez kılacak yoğunlukta olması.
Dağ keçisinin ve ayrıca yaban sığırının iri veya büyük oluşunun nitelenmesi.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynak anlatımı büyüklük ve genişliği, cömertlik ve çok verme ile ilişkilendirir; ayrıca bol sütlü dişi deveyi, kalabalık orduyu ve iri dağ keçisi ile yaban sığırını bu fazlalık alanına bağlar. Her kullanım kendi varlık türü ve niteliğiyle sınırlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Yalın biçimde büyük ve yıkıcı bir felaketi adlandırır. Kalıp biçimde yine felaket için kullanılabildiği gibi ateşli hastalığın veya herkesi alıp götürdüğü düşünülen ölümün adı da olur.

facets.statement: Büyük ve yıkıcı bir felaketin adlandırılması.

Ölüm adının, ölümün herkesi alıp götürmesi düşüncesiyle açıklanması.

Bu nedenle dal korunabilir, fakat geçici hayvanın kendini koruması çerçevesi bütün malzemeyi taşıyacak biçimde aksama ve ona bağlı kullanımlar olarak yeniden kurulmalıdır.

Hayvana yönelik emir kalıbı, onun aksayışını gözeterek yürümeyi sürdürme ve kendini zorlamama anlamı taşır.
Eyer için kullanıldığında hayvanın sırtını yaralamayan veya berelenmesine yol açmayan eyer anlatılır.
Sert ve engebeli zeminle kurulan olumsuz emir, arazinin güçlüğünden yakınmama anlamına gelir.
